comments.value: Basically, if a Dynamic Bone script uses any of its distribution curves and the converter decides to split it into multiple Phys Bone scripts with different Root Transforms to the original Root of the Dynamic Bone script, it does not convert correctly.

details:
SDK Version: VRCSDK3-AVATAR-2022.04.26.15.46_Public
I have a dynamic bone script on my head bone and use that to move 3 hair bones (all the other bones added as exclusions). As I don't want the root transform to rotate, I use distribution curves to set the dynamic bones up such that the bones can only rotate if they are far enough away from the root transform. Upon converting to Phys Bones (either in the editor or automatically in-game (build 1192)), these 3 hair bones no longer move at all.
In Unity, the converter splits this one DB script into multiple Phys Bone scripts, each with the root transform set to one of the 3 hair bones instead of the head bone. Changing the root transform like this changes how far each bone is along the chain of bones, but the converter doesn't take this change into account when converting the curves in the DB script to curves in the Phys Bone script.
In the image showing this issue, I have specifically set up and showed DB radius and PB collision radius curves because they convert 1:1, which makes the issue much more obvious.
If Phys Bone curves allowed keys with an x component outside of the [0,1] range, then fixing the curves I think would be as simple as finding the distance along the original DB bone chain that the new root transform is (where 0 is the root transform and 1 is the end of the bone chain), let's call that D. Then subtract D from the x component of each key in each converted Phys Bone curve and then scale the x components by 1/(1-D), effectively linearly remapping the range [D,1] to [0,1].

title: [BUG] Converter doesn't adjust curves when changing root transform
